title.narrative: Well-being and Resilience within Rural Communities in Tajikistan (WRRC)

description.narrative: Inclusive growth, based on improved agricultural production practices and sustainable natural resource management contributes to resilience against challenging (future) climate conditions and enhanced well-being (economic, social, health, environmental) within rural communities in Rasht valley, Tajikistan. Specific objective: Broad uptake of climate resilient practices enhances access to nutritious food, clean water, and resource and energy efficient solutions within watershed communities.
